name: server-dashboard
description: Live server health pane with deploy, rollback and health-check buttons, plus a guard against dangerous commands

appDir.title: App folder
appDir.description: Absolute path of the app's git repo on this server, e.g. /var/www/myapp (leave empty to skip app status)

restartCommand.title: Restart command
restartCommand.description: How the app restarts, e.g. sudo systemctl restart myapp, docker compose up -d --build, or pm2 restart myapp

healthUrl.title: Health check URL
healthUrl.description: A URL that answers 2xx when the app is up, e.g. http://localhost:3000/health
